label: Quectel EC25-E LTE Cat 4 mini PCIe module
description: LTE Cat 4 mini PCIe module (30 x 51 x 4.9 mm) at 150 Mbps down / 50 Mbps up with LTE-FDD/TDD, WCDMA and GSM fallback. The module exposes no ports of its own, so the host-facing data path is modelled as wan5g and a mini PCIe carrier is required.
